Ravi (arch): Heads-up: ran into a failure mode when hosted->private routing uses control-plane tokens the private adapter doesn't accept. Need a handshake pattern so private deployments can validate identity without exposing raw CP creds.
Becca (eng-runtime): curious — is this during fallback or normal routing?
Ravi (arch): during fallback. Hosted tried to route model traffic to customer VPC adapter; adapter returned 403 audience mismatch. Private customers often lock issuers.
Diego (eng-platform): seen that. Proposal: signed "proof" JWT from control-plane that adapter verifies against stored cert. Minimal caps, no raw tenant tokens.
Priya (sec): must be auditable and revocable. Constraints: TTL<=30s for hot paths, include nonce/rid to avoid replay, caps must be minimal.
Elena (product): onboarding needs automation; cert exchange ok if we make it painless.
Ravi (arch): sketch endpoints: GET /v1/capabilities -> lists auth modes + cert thumbprint; POST /v1/verify-proof -> adapter verifies signed proof.
Becca (eng-runtime): sample proof payload: {iss:controlplane, sub:tenant:acme, aud:adapter://acme-vpc, exp:..., rid:req-5f3a, caps:[route:model-pin] } + signature.
Priya (sec): add requirement for audit event on accept: proof.accepted with proof_id, origin, caps. Also include key-rotation guidance.
Diego (eng-platform): onboarding flow: control-plane stores adapter cert; discovery fetches cert thumbprint; route-time CP signs proof; adapter verifies. For customer-managed KMS adapters: adapter can expose an exchange URL to issue local tokens after its own checks (like exchange-handle model).
Becca (eng-runtime): perf notes: verifying per-request adds latency. Options: HMAC fast-path for hosted<->dedicated, asym crypto for unknown adapters, short-lived verification cache keyed by nonce. Cache TTL must be tiny.
Priya (sec): fail-closed unless adapter explicitly trial-mode. If cert rotated, discovery must include chain or fetch URL. Provide revoke endpoint /v1/revoke-proof for emergencies.
Diego (eng-platform): metrics to add: proof_verification_latency, proof_verify_fail_rate, capability_discovery_failures. ops-bot: created OPS-412.
ops-bot: ticket OPS-412 created: add proof verification metrics and alerts.
Ravi (arch): follow-ups: I'll write RFC with diagrams and HMAC fallback. Becca will spike verify latency; Diego will add metrics and revocation; Priya will author threat model.
Elena (product): docs + onboarding automation: target 2 sprints for new customers; existing can opt-in.
Ravi (arch): closing: keep raw tenant creds inside KMS; use short-lived proofs, minimal caps, nonce-bound, auditable. Thanks.
ops-bot: milestone created: adapter-proof-handshake (owner: becca)
